name: SkipClicks
author: Oddisz
description: Cuts the extra clicks out of planet surveys, salvage and battle loot. Adds a one-click Fast survey option to unsurveyed planets, skips the Assess and Explore step, the Continue screens and the accident report when salvaging, puts the leftover debris field into the salvage loot, opens cargo pods straight to their contents, and (with PatchLib installed) skips the Continue after ship recovery so the loot opens right away. Every skip can be turned off in the LunaLib settings.
